verdict.rationale: Stripe documents registrable HTTPS webhook endpoints that push real-time events, an MCP server that gives agents read and write access to the API, and built-in Smart Retries plus recovery analytics on failed payments. An agent can therefore monitor payment activity and lean on automatic retries. However, the evidence never names payment-failure webhook events, shows no agent-triggered retry action (MCP invoice methods cover create, finalize and void, not pay), and gives no documented dunning-outreach capability. Missing for 10: documented failed-payment webhook events, an agent-driven invoice payment retry via API, dunning email/outreach automation, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor failed payments via API and webhooks and drive retries and dunning outreach

citations.quote: After you register a webhook endpoint, Stripe pushes real-time data to it when events happen in your Stripe account.
Smart Retries: Automatically retry failed payments to prevent involuntary churn due to temporary issues.
Recovery analytics: Analyze subscription payment failure rates, recovery rates, and recent failed payments for top customers.
`stripe_api_read` ("Read data with any Stripe API GET method")
